description.value: Thai Ni Yom is an authentic Thai restaurant tucked into a unit on West 4th Avenue in Kitsilano, one of Vancouver's most cycle-friendly neighbourhoods. It operates as a full sit-down restaurant with table service and online ordering, making it a convenient meal stop for cyclists on the nearby Arbutus Greenway or the 4th Avenue corridor. The restaurant has been established long enough to earn a consistent OSM presence and maintains an active website with reservations and gift cards.
